columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Primary key for this table. System generated.

columns.name: DIRECTION_TYPE
columns.description: Stores the direction of request. (INBOUND or OUTBOUND)

columns.name: RESOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: Stores the type of REST invocation.

columns.name: RESOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Stores the name of REST resource.

columns.name: RESOURCE_URL
columns.description: Stores the path of REST resource.

columns.name: REQUEST_HEADERS
columns.description: Stores all request headers from the request.

columns.name: PAYLOAD_IN
columns.description: Stores input payload from the request.

columns.name: PAYLOAD_OUT
columns.description: Stores output  payload from the response.

columns.name: METHOD
columns.description: Stores HTTP method of the request.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Stores HTTP status of the response.

columns.name: STATUS_MESSAGE
columns.description: Stores HTTP status message of the response.

columns.name: PHASE_CODE
columns.description: Stores code identifying the category phase to which the service belongs.

columns.name: CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Stores the code for thrid party category.

columns.name: PROVISIONING_ID
columns.description: Identifies partner provisioning. Foreign Key to IRC_TP_PARTNER_PROVISNGS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
